data.name: SHIFU: Traffic Masters
data.detailed_description:
[Shifu 师傅: A skilled worker who has mastered their craft]

This is a driving game about life on the streets of a 1990s Chinese city.

Navigate dense streets filled with traffic, bicycles, and pedestrians. Master trucks, taxis, buses, and police cars, each with its own personality and challenges. The city reacts to your choices, and every type of job changes how you drive.

Five Ways to Make a Living

  • 🚛 Truck Cargo
    Haul loads across crowded streets. Every delivery tests your timing, precision, and adaptability.

  • 🚕 Taxi Fares
    Carry passengers through a busy city. Discover shortcuts, read the streets, and handle unexpected situations along the way.

  • 🚌 Bus Routes
    Manage full bus loads on tight schedules while navigating the flow of traffic. Every route brings new challenges.

  • 🚓 Police Chasing
    Pursue suspects through streets that never clear. Every chase is unpredictable and shaped by a living city.

  • 🏁 Street Racing
    Race across city circuits where knowing alleyways is more valuable than horsepower.

A City That Lives and Changes

  • Period correct vehicles from 80s-90s era, each handles differently.

  • Open world: take missions, free roam, or create your own chaos.

  • Dynamic traffic and environment: vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists react to your presence. Weather and road conditions can shift constantly.

  • Learn the streets: no GPS or route lines; the city rewards those who explore and master it

  • Bilingual support: Chinese and English fully integrated

data.short_description: Drive trucks, taxis, buses, and police cars through the bustling streets of a living 1990s Chinese city. Deliver cargo, transport passengers, chase suspects, and navigate traffic, bicycles, and pedestrians that never stop moving. Every vehicle handles differently, every job changes how you drive.
data.supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
